entries.en: Added `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER` environment variable to select a Bedrock service tier (`default`, `flex`, or `priority`), sent as the `X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier` header
entries.zh: 添加了`ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER`环境变量来选择 Bedrock 服务层（`default`、`flex`或`priority`），作为`X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier`标头发送

entries.en: Pasting a PR URL into the `/resume` search box now finds the session that created that PR (GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, and Bitbucket)
entries.zh: 将 PR 链接粘贴到 `/resume` 搜索框中，可以找到创建该 PR 的会话（支持 GitHub、GitHub Enterprise、GitLab 和 Bitbucket）

entries.en: OpenTelemetry: added `claude_code.at_mention` log event for `@`-mention resolution
entries.zh: OpenTelemetry：新增 `claude_code.at_mention` 日志事件，用于记录 `@` 提及的解析

entries.en: `/mcp` now shows claude.ai connectors hidden by a manually-added server with the same URL, with a hint to remove the duplicate
entries.zh: `/mcp` 现在会显示被同一 URL 的手动添加服务器隐藏的 claude.ai 连接器，并提示删除重复项

entries.en: Clarified the `/mcp` message shown when an MCP server is still unauthorized after the browser sign-in flow
entries.zh: 澄清了在浏览器登录流程后 MCP 服务器仍然未经授权时显示的`/mcp`消息

entries.en: OpenTelemetry: numeric attributes on `api_request`/`api_error` log events are now emitted as numbers, not strings
entries.zh: OpenTelemetry：`api_request`/`api_error` 日志事件中的数字属性现在以数字形式输出，而不是字符串

entries.en: Voice mode: keybindings bound to Caps Lock now show an error since terminals don't deliver Caps Lock as a key event
entries.zh: 语音模式：绑定到 Caps Lock 的快捷键现在会显示错误，因为终端不会把 Caps Lock 当作按键事件发送

entries.en: Fixed `/branch` producing forks that fail with "tool_use ids were found without tool_result blocks" when the source session contained entries from rewound timelines
entries.zh: 修复了当源会话包含来自倒回时间线的条目时，`/branch` 生成的分叉失败并显示“在没有 tool_result 块的情况下找到了 tool_use id”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` not showing the Effort option for Bedrock application inference profile ARNs, and those ARNs not receiving `output_config.effort`
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`未显示 Bedrock 应用程序推理配置文件 ARN 的“Effort”选项，以及那些 ARN 未接收`output_config.effort`的问题

entries.en: Fixed Vertex AI / Bedrock returning `invalid_request_error: output_config: Extra inputs are not permitted` on session-title generation and other structured-output queries
entries.zh: 修复了 Vertex AI / Bedrock 在会话标题生成和其他结构化输出查询中返回“invalid_request_error：output_config：不允许额外输入”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Vertex AI `count_tokens` endpoint returning 400 errors for users behind proxy gateways
entries.zh: 修复了 Vertex AI`count_tokens`端点为代理网关后面的用户返回 400 错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed `spinnerTipsOverride.excludeDefault` not suppressing the time-based spinner tips
entries.zh: 修复了`spinnerTipsOverride.excludeDefault`不抑制基于时间的微调器提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed ToolSearch missing MCP tools that connected after session start in nonblocking mode
entries.zh: 修复了 ToolSearch 丢失在非阻塞模式下会话启动后连接的 MCP 工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed `!exit` / `!quit` in bash mode terminating the CLI instead of running as a shell command
entries.zh: 修复了 bash 模式下的 `!exit` / `!quit` 终止 CLI，而不是作为 shell 命令运行

entries.en: Fixed images sent to newer models being resized to 2576px per side instead of the correct 2000px maximum
entries.zh: 修复了发送到较新型号的图像尺寸调整为每边 2576 像素，而不是正确的最大 2000 像素

entries.en: Fixed remote control session idle status redrawing twice per second, which could flood `tmux -CC` control pipes and pause the terminal
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制会话空闲状态每秒重绘两次，这可能会淹没`tmux -CC`控制管道并暂停终端

entries.en: Fixed assistant messages appearing blank in some sessions due to a stale view preference
entries.zh: 修复了由于陈旧的视图首选项而导致某些会话中助理消息显示为空白的问题

entries.en: Fixed a malformed hooks entry in `settings.json` no longer invalidating the entire file
entries.zh: 修复了`settings.json`中格式错误的钩子条目，不再使整个文件无效
